# uzc_vpc (Resource)

Manages a UzCloud VPC network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_vpc" "example" {
  name           = "example-vpc"
  cloud_provider = "nimbo"
  cidr           = "10.0.0.0/16"
  size           = 16
  plan           = "vpc-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) CIDR block for the VPC. Changing this forces recreation.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider slug. Changing this forces recreation.
- `name` (String) Name of the VPC. Mutable.
- `plan` (String) Plan slug. Changing this forces recreation.
- `size` (Number) VPC size (subnet size). Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle slug. Falls back to the provider's `billing_cycle` default when unset. Changing this forces recreation.
- `description` (String) Changing this forces recreation (the update endpoint does not accept it).
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset. Changing this forces recreation.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset. Changing this forces recreation.
- `storage_category` (String) Storage category slug. Changing this forces recreation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used in every /vpcs/{slug} call and for import.
- `type` (String) Always "Vpc".
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_vpc.example <vpc-slug>
```
